fun_fact: This month, a Cyclospora parasite outbreak traced to bagged lettuce sickened thousands across the US. One contaminated batch of chopped greens can pool leaves from thousands of lettuce heads, then ride consolidated supply chains into Walmart, Costco, Kroger and restaurant kitchens in dozens of states at once — Taylor Farms alone recalled iceberg lettuce sold in 27+ states. As fewer companies control what lands in our salads, wraps and tacos, a once-local contamination becomes a nationwide one. [Read more](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/cyclospora-outbreak-food-industry-consolidation.html)
